title: WFRP4e Engaged In Melee
description: Tracks melee Engagement (per WFRP4e Core p.159) and automatically applies the Outnumbering to-hit bonus (+20 at 2:1, +40 at 3:1, Core p.161) to melee tests. Engagement is established by attack actions, not by distance, and persists until a full Round passes without combat. Auto-disengage on movement uses the longer of the two combatants' equipped weapon reaches (per Core p.297).
